run_boost_build_shared: run the boost build system with link=shared to produce shared library artifacts
run_boost_build_static: run the boost build system with link=static to produce static library artifacts
create_boost_tester: create a BoostBuild Tester instance to set up a test environment for build verification
write_jamfile: write a jamfile.jam that defines static-lib and lib targets from a C++ source file
expect_addition_boost: verify that the build system produced expected output files like .lib and .dll artifacts
